_readme: Themed puzzles. This file is the ONLY place a theme is authored — the
generator merges it over the generated set, so an editor never touches code.
A theme claims a base word. Claimed bases are generated FIRST and win their
anagram slot, so a claim reliably lands. Clues written here override the
auto-generated Webster ones; anything not overridden falls back, so a theme
Clue rules, enforced by the build (it prints what it rejected and why):
- never contain the answer or a 4+ character stem of it
- no two rows in a puzzle may pose the same question
VOICE NOTE: these are a first draft written to prove the pipeline and give
an editor something to react to. They should be revised by someone with
